**Full `LlmstxtSettings` option set** (verbatim from `dist/index.d.ts`), including inherited `TemplateVariables`:

Template variables (inherited, also usable as top-level options):
- `title?: string`
- `description?: string`

Core options:
- `domain?: string` — prepended to URLs in outputs; must **not** end with `/`.
- `generateLLMsTxt?: boolean` (default `true`) — emit `llms.txt` (link index).
- `generateLLMsFullTxt?: boolean` (default `true`) — emit `llms-full.txt` (whole site in one file).
- `generateLLMFriendlyDocsForEachPage?: boolean` (default `true`) — per-page `.md` outputs.
- `stripHTML?: boolean` (default `true`).
- `injectLLMHint?: boolean` (default `true`) — inserts machine-visible/human-hidden hint text on every page.
- `workDir?: string` (default `vitepress.srcDir`) — the directory processed; **the documented use case is exactly per-language scoping**, e.g. `workDir: 'en'`.
- `ignoreFiles?: string[]` (default `[]`) — glob patterns excluded from all outputs (e.g. `'about/team/*'`, `'sponsor/*'`).
- `ignoreFilesPerOutput?: { llmsTxt?: string[]; llmsFullTxt?: string[]; pages?: string[] }` — per-output ignore patterns **merged** with global `ignoreFiles`; each supports `!`-prefixed negation.
- `excludeUnnecessaryFiles?: boolean` (default `true`) — drop blog/sponsor/team-type files.
- `excludeIndexPage?: boolean` (default `true`).
- `excludeBlog?: boolean` (default `true`).
- `excludeTeam?: boolean` (default `true`).
- `customLLMsTxtTemplate?: string` — template with `{title}`, `{description}`, `{details}`, `{toc}` placeholders plus custom vars.
- `customTemplateVariables?: Record<string, string | undefined>`.
- `sidebar?: DefaultTheme.Sidebar | ((configSidebar) => ... )` — override sidebar source.
- `experimental?: { depth?: number }` (default `1`) — how many directory levels deep to emit `llms.txt` files (`1` = root only, `2` = root + first-level subdirs, etc.).

- `docs:api:locales` / `docs:api:locales:claude` → `build-api-locales.ts`

- `docs:build` runs assets → `docs:api:locales` → `docs:check:locales` → `vitepress build`.

# Scope the llms output to English, keep per-page Hungarian markdown

## Context

`vitepress-plugin-llms` (v1.13.3) is registered in `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` with only `title`
and `description`. With no `workDir` or `ignoreFiles`, it runs over VitePress's full `srcDir`
(`docs/`), so the machine-translated Hungarian mirror at `docs/hu/**` — a full copy of the guides
*and* the entire API reference — gets folded into the same `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` as
English. That roughly doubles `llms-full.txt` and pollutes the index with derivative, duplicate
content in a second language that adds no information for an LLM, only noise and tokens. The plugin
author's README explicitly recommends English-only output for LLMs.

**Goal:** keep the two aggregate indexes (`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`) English-only, while still
emitting per-page LLM-friendly `.md` for Hungarian pages, and add a one-line prose note that a
Hungarian translation exists. Small config change, no new code — uses the plugin's built-in options.

## Change

Single edit to the `llmstxt({...})` call in [docs/.vitepress/config.ts:365](docs/.vitepress/config.ts:365):

```ts
llmstxt({
  title: "pantoken",
  description,
  // Hungarian (docs/hu/**) is a machine-translated mirror of the English source. Keep it out of
  // the aggregate indexes so llms.txt / llms-full.txt stay canonical-English (the plugin author's
  // own guidance), but leave per-page .md generation on so a /hu/ page can still be fetched as
  // markdown. Patterns are minimatch against paths relative to workDir (docs/), so `hu/**` matches
  // hu/index.md and every hu/guide/** and hu/api/** file.
  details:
    "This index covers the canonical English documentation. A Hungarian translation of every page is available under /hu/.",
  ignoreFilesPerOutput: {
    llmsTxt: ["hu/**"],
    llmsFullTxt: ["hu/**"],
  },
}) as never,
```

Notes:
- `details` renders near the top of `llms.txt`, after the title and `description` blockquote.
  Wording follows repo voice rules (active voice, plain language, no banned terms).
- `ignoreFilesPerOutput` filters only the two aggregate outputs; the per-page `pages` output is left
  untouched, so `docs/hu/**` pages still get their own `.md` (confirmed in `dist/index.js` — the
  `pages` patterns are resolved independently from `llmsTxt`/`llmsFullTxt`).
- No change to the existing `description` constant (line 235) or the `${base}llms.txt` nav link
  (lines ~435).

content in a second language that adds no information for an LLM, only noise and tokens. The plugin
author's README explicitly recommends English-only output for LLMs.

emitting per-page LLM-friendly `.md` for Hungarian pages, and add a one-line prose note that a
Hungarian translation exists. Small config change, no new code — uses the plugin's built-in options.
